results.notes: Solved the 9x9 linear system for v and w by Gaussian elimination on the augmented matrix. Verified against original vectors.
Computed B^{-1} via Gaussian elimination of augmented 6x6 matrix, then multiplied B^{-1} * (A * B). All intermediate calculations verified for integer consistency.
Computed Gram matrix of 6 vectors in R^7 via dot products, then determinant via systematic elimination with fractional pivots and integer scaling, yielding 2800.
Solved normal equations A^T A x = A^T b via Gaussian elimination with exact fractions. Verified by checking row1 and row4 of original system.
Solved 10x10 system via Gaussian elimination to upper triangular form and back substitution. Solution involves one fraction: x5=9/2.
Computed sequential product of 23 matrices, obtained final 3x3 matrix, trace sum of diagonal entries.
Solved normal equations Gx=d where G=W^T W, d=W^T b. Back-substitution gave coefficients x, then computed projection coordinates.
Used Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to compute squared norms of orthogonal vectors. Verified via Gram determinants and determinant of original matrix A (det=-2).
Performed row reduction to RREF. Found 6 non-zero rows with leading 1s at columns 1,3,7,8,10,11.
Computed RREF via Gaussian elimination. Pivot columns: 1,2,3,4,7,8,9. Final matrix has 7 nonzero rows. All entries are integers.
